top_categories.workout_context: 278 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 278 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
278 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca's mixed terrain actually does to you.
Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 278 miles.
At Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca. Train it until it feels boring.
Tempo is Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 278 miles on mixed terrain. Train it until it's automatic.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.heat: April in Mallorca, Spain can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Cinturón Ciclista a Mallorca and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Fueling for 278 miles requires a practiced plan matched to expected duration, intensity, tolerance, and the course's confirmed feed or commercial resupply options. Rehearse the plan on long rides, begin early, carry redundant fuel, and avoid treating a fixed total-calorie estimate as a race prescription.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Endurance, and HVLI Extended to prepare you for 278 miles of mixed terrain in Mallorca, Spain.
